description: Unbounded variable-length traversal on a cyclic graph terminating via relationship uniqueness.

sqlpgq.reason: PostgreSQL SQL/PGQ (experimental: PostgreSQL 19 Beta 1-3 and 20 development builds) does not support element pattern quantifiers such as '->{1,}' (its parser rejects the open upper bound with a syntax error, and bounded forms with 'element pattern quantifier is not supported').
